name: punch-list
description: One to-do list of things waiting on you, shared by every Claude Code session: Claude adds an item whenever it tells you to do something, a band above the prompt shows what's open, and /todo lists, ticks off and snoozes them.

file.title: List file
file.description: The JSON file every session shares. Empty: punch-list.json in the Claude config folder ($CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR, else ~/.claude).

band.title: Band above the prompt
band.description: Shows the open count and the top items above the prompt. /todo band on|off overrides it.

statusLine.title: Status line count
statusLine.description: Shows 'to-do N' in the status line too.

pollSeconds.title: Check for changes (seconds)
pollSeconds.description: How often to look for changes other sessions made to the list; 0 checks only on each prompt.
